terrain.credit: Service public de Wallonie (SPW) - Relief de la Wallonie - Modèle Numérique de Terrain (MNT) 2021-2022 (2024-01-23)
terrain.modifications: Sparse point sampling and coarse grid; heights offset by baseline. Renderer adds an authored 18–80m blend to the separately sampled road. No surveyed earthwork or chair geometry.

vegetation_evidence: Authored samples within OSM forest polygons, not mapped individual trees. Heights, crowns and event clearing are illustrative.
